title: Ask all adults about tobacco use

source.quote: The USPSTF recommends that clinicians ask all adults about tobacco use, advise them to stop using tobacco, and provide behavioral interventions and US Food and Drug Administration (FDA)--approved pharmacotherapy for cessation to nonpregnant adults who use tobacco.

action: Clinicians ask all adults about tobacco use.

derived.min: text says 'adults' without an age; adult assumed to mean age 18 or older

numerator.quote: ask all adults about tobacco use

derived.window: text gives no interval; asking within the measurement year is assumed
